## What is Koodisi?

Koodisi is an enterprise integration platform. You build [applications](https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-applications/) from [workflows](https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-workflows/) and [activities](https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-activities/), govern the contracts they exchange in the [schema registry](https://docs.koodisi.com/working-with-the-schema-registry/), publish them as secured [APIs and AI tools](https://docs.koodisi.com/api-manager/), and then [monitor](https://docs.koodisi.com/the-metrics-dashboard/) what they do in production.
